props.name: className
props.comment: A class name to apply to the wrapper.

props.name: i18n
props.comment: Translates the pagination and no-results text. English without one.

props.name: page
props.comment: The page to render, as `loadServerListPage` returns it.

props.name: path
props.comment: The list's pathname: every sort and page link is this path plus its query.

props.name: rowActions
props.comment: What the last cell of each row renders.
